properties.displayName: UAV S13 - Satellite Link C2 Hijacking (Regular Beaconing over Whitelisted Endpoint)
properties.description: UAVSatcomLink_CL(실제 컬럼: UAVId, LinkId, SessionId, Seq, IntegrityStatus, RttMs, JamIndicator, SrcAddr, DstAddr, Mode, Encoding, PayloadEntropy, BeaconJitterSec, PayloadBytes — LinkType 없음)에서 SrcAddr/DstAddr가 Watchlist(C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List)에 없는 비인가 엔드포인트, 또는 BeaconJitterSec가 매우 낮아 기계적으로 규칙적인 비컨(beacon) 패턴을 보이는 세션을 탐지 — Turla(G0010) 스타일의 정상 위성 세션에 편승한 C2 비컨/태스킹 트래픽 은닉 기법. MITRE Enterprise ATT&CK: T1090.002 Proxy: External Proxy
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 2h;
let minSamples = 8;
let jitterThreshold = 0.05;
let WhitelistedGCS = _GetWatchlist('C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List') | project GCS_IP;
UAVSatcomLink_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| extend isUnwhitelisted = (SrcAddr !in (WhitelistedGCS)) and (DstAddr !in (WhitelistedGCS))
| summarize
    MaxTime = max(TimeGenerated),
    SampleCount = count(),
    AvgJitter = avg(BeaconJitterSec),
    StdevJitter = stdev(BeaconJitterSec),
    AvgEntropy = avg(PayloadEntropy),
    AvgRtt = avg(RttMs),
    UnwhitelistedCount = countif(isUnwhitelisted),
    SrcSet = make_set(SrcAddr),
    DstSet = make_set(DstAddr)
    by UAVId, LinkId, SessionId
| where SampleCount >= minSamples
| where (AvgJitter < jitterThreshold) or (UnwhitelistedCount > 0)
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    UnwhitelistedCount > 0, strcat('SATCOM_비인가_엔드포인트_', tostring(UnwhitelistedCount), '건'),
    strcat('SATCOM_C2_규칙비컨_탐지_지터', tostring(round(AvgJitter,4)), 's'))
| extend Severity = 'High'
| project TimeGenerated = MaxTime, UAVId, LinkId, SessionId, SampleCount, AvgJitter, StdevJitter, AvgEntropy, AvgRtt, UnwhitelistedCount, SrcSet, DstSet, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S13 - Satellite Link C2 Hijacking (Regular Beaconing over Whitelisted Endpoint) - {{UAVId}}
